high_level_description: The image depicts a nighttime scene outside the White House. The setting is illuminated by artificial lighting, with the iconic white building prominently featured in the background. In the foreground, several police officers are standing in formation, equipped with riot gear including helmets and shields labeled "POLICE." They appear to be prepared for potential unrest or a protest. The mood of the image is tense and serious, reflecting the gravity of the situation. The officers' stance and the presence of their protective equipment suggest they are ready to respond to any disturbances.
